name: UGC Creators (Billo)
description: Custom short-form video ads produced by vetted US/UK creators for TikTok Ads, Meta Reels, and Amazon Product Pages.
fullDescription: Billo makes custom User Generated Content (UGC) video production affordable and rapid for direct-to-consumer and Amazon sellers. By connecting brands with thousands of vetted everyday creators across the United States and United Kingdom, brands receive ready-to-launch video ads in under 7 days.
features: Network of over 5,000+ vetted everyday creators across North America and the UK
Standardized video formats: unboxing, product tutorials, testimonial, 360 showcase
Full commercial rights and raw footage licenses included with every order
Average 5-7 business day turnaround from creator product receipt to finished video
Designed specifically for high-CTR TikTok Spark Ads, Reels, and Amazon Brand Stores
